sentences.en: By learning from the city growth mechanism, the rivalship and evolvement of niche and evolvement of urban spacial frame were discussed.

sentences.en: In the environment of rivalship, cost has become the most important factor of core competence of enterprise.

sentences.en: Now, we are confronted with the challenge of WTO and rivalship in international market and home market.

sentences.en: Because innovation and advancement of technique is accomplished by human being, rivalship of technique depends on rivalship of human being after all.

sentences.en: Cooperation is better than containment, dialogue is better than confrontation, and partnership is better than rivalship.
sentences.vi: Hợp tác tốt hơn ngăn cản, đối thoại tốt hơn đối đầu và quan hệ đối tác tốt hơn đối thủ.
